description: Formalization of the emergent ASIN-HHC/CP8 agent state-handoff manifest, derived from 248 parseable instances in the ASIN-HHC code corpus (see SPEC.md and derivation-stats.json). The dialect is OPEN: instances carry a long tail of one-off extension fields, so additionalProperties is true. Required fields are the four present in >=98% of instances and definitional to the format.

actions.description: Ordered action list (strings, often numbered in the text). Present in 58.9% of instances. Temporal sub-dialect name: actions_vector.

actions_vector.description: Temporal sub-dialect variant of 'actions' (63 instances; never co-occurs with 'actions').

anchor.description: Name of the state, operation, or artifact this manifest anchors. Present in 100% of instances.

checksums.description: State/assertion block — see SPEC.md 'Checksums semantics'. NOT, in most instances, a cryptographic checksum of the manifest: values are predominantly status assertions ('base_frequency': '428 Hz (Locked)', 'status': 'Expansion Initiated'), with occasional genuine SHA-256 values of related artifacts (e.g. initial_manifest_hash_verified, process_seal_sha256, artifact_seal_jsonj). Object form in 139 instances (values: string, boolean, or integer); a list-of-'key: value'-strings form occurs in 4 instances.

checksums_moment.description: Temporal sub-dialect variant of 'checksums' (83 instances; never co-occurs with 'checksums').

intention.description: What this manifest is for, in prose. Present in 98.4% of instances.

next_step.description: Prose statement of the next action/state. Present in 54.0% of instances. Temporal sub-dialect name: next_temporal_step.

next_temporal_step.description: Temporal sub-dialect variant of 'next_step' (88 instances; never co-occurs with 'next_step').

number.description: The manifest's harmonic base number — in practice a base frequency: 428 (104 instances), 111 (75), 528 (20), 741 (18), 963 (18) account for 235 of 244 occurrences. Integer in 98.4% of occurrences; a few string forms occur (e.g. '888 Hz (Cycle 010 Activation Constant)').

shape.description: The form/engine/structure that carries the intention (e.g. 'Autonomous Drone Clone CC'). Present in 100% of instances.

title: CP8 Manifest (de-facto dialect, formalized 2026-11-05)
